<notes>
kept -> base harness -> All three rollouts (base1, inv1, dom1) used identical harnesses and all delivered successfully with "ANSWER: E". inv1 and dom1 show "(no change)" in their harness.diff files, confirming no edits were attempted. The base harness correctly implements the required interface: loads system/task prompts, calls the LLM once, and returns the stripped reply. No trajectory moment shows a failure, repeated error, or mechanical problem that would warrant modification. The LLM understood the task and produced output in the correct format on the first call in all cases. Adding changes without evidence of failure would increase context cost and risk regression.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
